facts.fact: STATAFRIC's peer review press release credits Equatorial Guinea with a modernised Statistics Law aligned with the African Charter on Statistics, and refers to it as the 2020 Statistics Law.
The Equatorial Guinea press office reports the national statistics institute director saying a new statistics law was promulgated in 2020, after Law 3/2001 regulating statistical activity.

The press office reports 133 trained statisticians were appointed to ministerial statistics units on 10 December 2024 under the INEGE ministerial statistical services project, 'as the law stipulates'.
